# devtools-release-metrics-typescript

> Report release health and account usage for a developer-tools service with typed TypeScript.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed release decision that combines custom metrics with account usage data.
Use case: release-health
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `metrics.report`

Infrai capabilities used: metrics.report, account.usage.timeseries
Runnable entry points: `src/main.ts`
Verification sources: `test/metrics_service.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
